items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: I’m using, with three students I’m using the Coker book, Patterns for Jazz, and they eat it right up.

ctx.x: Have the students, have you noticed a difference in their motivation and how well they prepare for their lessons.

Oh definitely, definitely. Well most of these kids play in bands in school, and the bands keep them practicing on their horns. The bands meet two or three times a week. So now they don’t have that. Once in a while their school bands write to them and say, “Please record this piece, we have a click track” you know. So they do that. But mostly they’re not practicing that much. They’re not playing their horns that much. But the compensating factor is that I am finally able to give them a little bit of theory and…
I think you had mentioned this student during our first interview.
